title: Prompt registry
boundary: Registry selection only. This never applies agent files, model configuration or runtime changes. Do not store credentials.
denied: An active company administrator session is required. Data is hidden after any read failure.
order: Pages use UUID order, not chronology. Only selected revision and head receipt are authoritative.
head: Head receipt
loadReceipt: Load receipt pages until the current head receipt is available before rollback.
confirm: I confirm this changes only the registry selection, not any running agent or model.
conflict: Head changed or request identity conflicts. Reloaded state; inspect and confirm a new intent.
rejected: Request rejected. Inspect current state before creating a new intent.
unknown: Response uncertain. The frozen request must be retried with the same ID to recover its durable result. No new intent is allowed yet.
